subject: Mutual Action Plan — Acme Corp MAP & Next Steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Sara Lee <sara.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft (next steps)
Attachments: Acme-Redwood-MAP-v1.xlsx

Hi Alex / Sara —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re all aligned and to propose a Mutual Action Plan (attached) to keep momentum: 

Key pain points you raised:
- High per-token inference costs on current vendor causing margin pressure for real-time features.
- Frequent latency spikes during peak sessions impacting UX for support agents.
- Lack of clear rollout path from POC to production with cost/latency SLOs.

Top goals:
1) Move a core chat flow to Redwood Dedicated for predictability and a 30% unit-cost reduction.
2) Achieve median p99 inference latency under 200ms for 1k concurrent sessions.
3) Production rollout by end of Q4 with SLOs and rollback plan.

Decision process & stakeholders (from today):
- Eva Moreno (VP Product) — final sign-off on product impact
- Chris Patel (Head of Infrastructure) — technical approval and security
- Monica Rivera (Procurement) — contract/terms, target to complete procurement by 10/15/2026

Proposed next steps (see attached MAP):
1) 09/01 — Demo of Dedicated performance (benchmarking with your sample workload) — Redwood SE: Dev Patel (cc).
2) 09/08 — Price & Sizing proposal + list of required infra/security artifacts for PO.
3) 09/22 — Pilot kickoff (2 weeks) + evaluation criteria.
4) 10/15 — Procurement completion / PO.
5) 11/01 — Production rollout (stage-based).

Ask: Please confirm that stakeholders and dates above align with your internal plan. I attached a MAP template with milestones and owners — I can update it after you confirm.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

--
Acme demo notes attached.

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sara Lee <sara.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Chris Patel <chris.patel@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (next steps)

Marissa —

Thanks for the quick recap and for capturing the MAP. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement timeline: Monica is targeting internal approvals by 10/10 and external POs by 10/20; we’ll see where legal lands on terms.
- Decision owner: Eva will sign off but Chris and I will be the primary technical reviewers during the pilot.
- Pilot scope: We want the pilot to include the agent chat flow + embed retrieval path (latency critical).

The dates look reasonable — can you confirm Redwood will run the Dedicated benchmarking with KV/cache settings similar to our production traces? Also please include an egress cost estimate for cross-region traffic (we have some EU users).

On the MAP: I reviewed the attached spreadsheet and added a few rows for procurement contacts and legal review.

Alex
Head of Product
Acme Corp

Alex / Sara —

Appreciate the feedback. I’ve attached an updated MAP (tabbed by milestone) and a light SOW draft for internal review. Highlights/updates from our side: 

- Dedicated bench: Redwood will run the benchmark using your sample traces and enable KV prefix caching. Dev (cc) will coordinate data ingestion for the test.
- Egress: Included a preliminary cross-region egress estimate in the pricing tab — we’ll refine after pilot traffic profiling.
- Pilot evaluation criteria (suggested): 1) Throughput to support 1k concurrent sessions, 2) p99 latency < 200ms, 3) token cost reduction target >= 25% vs current vendor.

Updated MAP milestones (high level):
- 09/01 — Benchmark/demo (Redwood SE + Acme SE) — Owner: Marissa / Dev
- 09/08 — Finalize pricing & infra checklist — Owner: Marissa
- 09/13 — Legal review starts (Acme Legal) — Owner: Monica Rivera
- 09/22 — Pilot kickoff (2 weeks) — Owner: Chris Patel / Dev
- 10/15 — Procurement / PO target — Owner: Monica Rivera

Please review the attached and mark any owner/date changes inline in the sheet. If this looks good I’ll request a short working-session on 09/02 to align Dev / Infra and finalize the benchmark inputs.

Thanks,

Marissa
